name: crewmesh
description: CrewMesh — Race-proof team formation service for Hack4Hack Crew Hiring Challenge 2026 (PS1)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run test --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.test:unit:sandbox: node --test apps/api/test/phase1.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch2.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch3.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch4.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch5.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch6.unit.test.mjs apps/api/test/batch7.unit.test.mjs
